tasks.title: Implement URL validation logic for POST /check
tasks.description: Create src/checkHandler.ts. Implement input validation: reject requests where req.body.url is absent or not a string (HTTP 400 'url is required and must be a string'), reject URLs that fail the URL constructor (HTTP 400 'Invalid URL: <message>'), and reject URLs whose protocol is not http: or https: (HTTP 400 'URL must use http or https protocol'). Return a well-typed Express Router. No fetch or DB calls in this task.
done_criteria: src/checkHandler.ts exists and exports an Express Router
Missing url field returns HTTP 400 { error: 'url is required and must be a string' }
Invalid URL string returns HTTP 400 { error: 'Invalid URL: ...' }
Non-http/https protocol returns HTTP 400 { error: 'URL must use http or https protocol' }
tasks.commit_message_template: C2-TASK-1: implement URL validation for POST /check

tasks.title: Implement outbound HTTP fetch with high-resolution timing
tasks.description: In src/checkHandler.ts, after URL validation passes: record startNs = process.hrtime.bigint(), call fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000) }), record endNs after fetch resolves or rejects. Compute responseTimeMs = Math.round(Number(endNs - startNs) / 1_000_000 * 10) / 10 (1 decimal place). On success extract response.status as statusCode; on AbortError or other error set statusCode = null and capture err.message. This task does not persist to DB yet.
done_criteria: process.hrtime.bigint() is used for timing (not Date.now())
AbortError is caught and results in statusCode=null
responseTimeMs is computed to 1 decimal place
tasks.commit_message_template: C2-TASK-2: implement outbound HTTP fetch with hrtime timing in check handler

tasks.title: Integrate DB persistence and finalise POST /check response
tasks.description: In src/checkHandler.ts, after timing and fetch, call C-4 insertCheck({ url, status_code: statusCode, response_time_ms: responseTimeMs, error: errorMsg ?? null }). Use the returned CheckRow (which includes id and checked_at) as the HTTP 200 response body. Ensure the handler never throws unhandled exceptions to Express.
done_criteria: insertCheck is called with correct arguments after fetch
HTTP 200 response body is the full CheckRow returned by insertCheck
All fetch errors are caught; none propagate as unhandled exceptions
tasks.commit_message_template: C2-TASK-3: integrate DB persistence and finalise POST /check response
